# The Edge

> The Edge is a seven-storey office building in Dubai Internet City, the technology free zone off Sheikh Zayed Road. Certified LEED Gold, it offers around 81,600 sq ft of flexible office floor plates above ground-floor retail, with a double-height lobby and more than 8,300 sq m of underground parking - one of the highest parking ratios in the district. Its tenants include Oracle and Snapchat, alongside cafes and casual dining at street level.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Internet City, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2016

## MENASCO Scope

The Edge is a seven-storey office building in Dubai Internet City, developed by Sweid & Sweid and designed by Brewer Smith Brewer Group to a LEED Gold rating. Planned around flexible floor plates, a double-height lobby and underground parking, it is home to technology tenants including Oracle and Snapchat. MENASCO carried out the MEP works for the building.
